messages:
maria: Quick sync — I'm working on perms UX for per-route routing policies + quota scopes. High-level idea: show effective permissions inline in the Console next to each route and allow admins to 'simulate as' a role/token to preview routing decisions and quota applicability. Thoughts?

jon: Strong 👍 on simulation. big Q: do we compute 'effective' client-side or server-side? client might be snappier but risks stale policy logic.

rina: From design: compact representation: a small 'Effective access' pill next to route name. Click opens a modal with a simulated request form (role, tenant, attributes) and a result pane showing route chosen, fallback, and quota bucket.

devin: SRE note: simulation must never execute real downstream routing or consume quota. We need a sandbox evaluation endpoint that runs the policy engine in read-only mode and returns a deterministic decision. Also audits each sim.

ash: Implementation detail: policy precedence = tenant-level overrides -> route-level -> global defaults. We should show the precedence trace in the modal. Also surface the quota window (e.g., 100 req/min) and current usage if admin has visibility.

maria: Agree. UX question: do we default the modal to 'per-role' simulation or 'per-user'? I think role-first for enterprise flows.

jon: role-first makes sense. For the server-side sim API sketch:```json
POST /admin/simulate-policy
{
  "role": "tenant-admin",
  "tenant_id": "t_1234",
  "route": "/generate",
  "attrs": {"region": "us-west-2", "model": "gpt-open-35"},
  "simulate": true
}
```
Response should include decision, matched rules, fallback candidate, and a "precedence_trace" list.

rina: UX: include an expandable 'why' section that maps matched rule -> human-friendly reason. Tooltip for precedence.

ash: Telemetry: each simulation should produce an audit event with actor, params, and result (redacted). We'll also tag sims that changed rule logic compared to previous policy snapshot so teams can catch regressions.

devin: Security: simulators should be gated by a permission so only people with audit/sim privileges can run them. Rate-limit sims per-admin (10/min) to avoid abuse. Add sticky notice that sims don't affect real quota.

maria: Rollout plan: feature-flag the Console UI and the /simulate-policy endpoint. Canary to 10% of orgs, then 100% after 2 weeks if no issues. Need flag controls per-tenant in Dedicated.

ash: Edge-case: service accounts that have token-scoped ephemeral grants. Simulator needs to accept an optional 'effective_token_scopes' array to mimic ephemeral grants.

jon: Dev note: storing policy snapshots for "diff on simulate" will need ~30d retention by default in telemetry. Might be big; we can sample sims that produce diffs.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: sandbox simulate endpoint v1 deployed to staging :rocket: logs at https://staging.logs/sim-202

maria: Nice. I'll draft an RFC today covering API contract, UI mock, telemetry events, rate limits, and rollout. @jon @rina @devin @ash please add comments on the RFC when I share. :thumbsup:
